# s2_1_dupecheck

**In one sentence:** A leftover alias package that only re-exports the duplicate-finding helpers from `../dedupe.py`.

## What's inside
| File / folder | What it does |
|---|---|
| `__init__.py` | Re-exports `_compute_hashes`, `_find_duplicates`, `_resolve_duplicates` from `curate/dedupe.py`. No code of its own. |

## Who uses it
- Nothing imports this package. `curate/step.py` and `invoke/mock_curate.py` import `curate.dedupe` directly.
- The name survives only as a string in `prepare_lora_kit/utils/state.py` (`_SUBSTEP_MIGRATIONS`), which renames the old substep id `s2_1_dupecheck` to `duplicate_check` when reading old run-state files. That mapping does not need this folder.

## Good to know
Looks like dead code from an older "one folder per substep" layout. The real logic lives in `../dedupe.py` (see `../FOLDER_GUIDE.md`).
